symptom: report all panics in the dependencies stage with "cannot create context from nil parent" (with a Marketplace token and Marketplace modules) and writes nothing, losing the reports already computed; without the panic its vulnerability check fails as "net/http: nil Context"
cause: report all and report readiness call each kind's collect with that kind's cobra command, which cobra never executed, so cmd.Context() is nil; files were only written after every kind was collected, and a panic in a collector was not recovered
insight: A cobra command called directly instead of through Execute has no context: give it the caller's (SetContext) at the one place that calls collectors, not in each collector. And a roll-up must treat one kind's panic like its error, and write each result as it is finished
